name: Trending
description: A Home row of what is trending, filled by the metadata providers you have set up in Specula. This add-on serves nothing: it describes a row, and Specula draws it.

fields.title: Metadata providers
fields.footnote: Which of the providers you have set up fill this row, in your order. None chosen means every one that can.

fields.title: Trending over
